name: Model Portfolio Benchmark Volatility Audit (ETF vs Index)
description: Empirical audit of the ETF-benchmark vs INDEX-benchmark volatility difference visible in the Model Portfolios -> Benchmarks tab -> Return vs Volatility (period volatility) chart. Both vols are computed gold-side by yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks Lambda using identical methodology (np.std * sqrt(252) * 100) against two different daily-return series; structurally ETF vol >= INDEX vol expected from microstructure overlay (premium/discount, bid-ask spread effects, tracking error, dividend cadence, embedded fees BIL ~14bps / AGG ~3bps / IVV ~3bps). This project confirms empirically whether the published difference is consistent with that framing or surfaces a specific data-construction / methodology anomaly.
phase: Phase 0 -- DISPATCHED 2026-05-19 (1.0.0_SA_CTO, Andrew-direct authorization); RAVC2 received 2026-05-19 (DS~B brief at docs/briefs/mdlp-etf-vs-index-volatility-audit-20260519.md). Audit verdict TWO-PART: (a) 6 of 9 periods (1M, QTD, 1Q, YTD, 1Y, SI) microstructure-explainable per CTO framing -- ETF >= INDEX structurally; stdev ratios 1.05-1.24 monotonic with equity weight; correlation 0.92-0.97 (UST/ST above 0.95 threshold; INT/LT below but consistent with bond+equity-blend tracking error over a window containing 2 stress days); residual lag-1 autocorr -0.38 to -0.57 (canonical mean-reverting tracking-error signature). (b) 3 of 9 periods (1D / WTD / MTD) surfaced a SEPARATE Lambda-output anomaly -- all 5 models emit byte-identical 1D=WTD=MTD entries across all 3 vol axes + return axes; local execution against the same pickle reproduces correctly differentiated values; deployed binary md5 == repo md5 byte-for-byte (code is not the variable). DS~B hypothesis: pandas/numpy runtime divergence under AWSSDKPandas-Python312:16 Layer, OR Lambda-Linux-container date arithmetic divergence, OR a runtime-conditional branch. MDLP_VOLAUD.002 (AE 0.5.0 lane, ae-lambda-runtime-1d-wtd-mtd-anomaly-investigation) DISPATCHED 2026-05-19 (2.0.0_SA_COO, GO) per CTO routing + standing extension-TO offer; ~1d SLA. Project stays open until .002 closes; audit verdict already partially landed.
